info.name: Amazon Bedrock Converse Model Customization API
Amazon Bedrock List model customization jobs

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

items.docs: Returns a list of model customization jobs that you have submitted.

info.name: Amazon Bedrock Create a model customization job

items.docs: Creates a fine-tuning job to customize a foundation model. You provide training data, a base model, and output configuration to produce a custom model tailored to your use case.

info.name: Amazon Bedrock Get model customization job details

params.name: jobIdentifier
params.description: The identifier of the customization job.

items.docs: Retrieves the properties associated with a model customization job, including the status, creation time, and training metrics.
